name: Pengda 1000DIA
tagline: High-Speed Industrial Oil-Heated Rotary Sublimation Transfer Machine

keySpecification.description: Advanced industrial sublimation transfer technology designed to maximize productivity, ensure uniform heat fixation, and support diverse polyester fabric applications.

rows.label: Heating System
rows.value: Oil Heating (Even Heat Across Full Drum Width)

rows.label: Compatible Fabric
rows.value: Polyester · Synthetic Blends · All sublimation-compatible fabrics

inkCompatibility.description: Designed to work with all sublimation-printed transfer papers, delivering vibrant, wash-fast results across polyester and synthetic blend fabrics.

inkTypes.name: Sublimation Heat Transfer
inkTypes.fabrics: Works with all sublimation-printed transfer papers produced by Epson-based, Kyocera-based, and industrial sublimation printers for transfer onto polyester and synthetic blend fabrics

inkTypes.name: Polyester Fabrics
inkTypes.fabrics: All polyester weaves, knits, and blended fabrics suitable for sublimation heat transfer

inkTypes.name: Synthetic Blends
inkTypes.fabrics: Polyester-cotton blends and synthetic mix fabrics where polyester content is sufficient for sublimation transfer quality

features.description: Engineered with smart automation and precision technology for reliable, efficient, and high-performance sublimation transfer

items.title: Oil Heating System
items.desc: Thermal oil circulation delivers consistent, uniform heat across the full 1600 mm drum width, eliminating hot and cold spots that cause uneven colour transfer or incomplete fixation.

items.title: Multifunction Transfer Capability
items.desc: Supports both roll-to-roll and pre-cut piece transfer modes from a single machine, giving operators the flexibility to switch between bulk fabric runs and individual garment piece transfers as required.

items.title: High-Speed Transfer at Up to 600 m/hr
items.desc: Industrial-grade rotary drum design enables transfer speeds of up to 600 metres per hour, making the Pengda the fastest calender option available for high-volume sublimation transfer operations.

items.title: Touch Panel Control System
items.desc: Intuitive touchscreen interface provides real-time operator control over transfer speed, drum temperature, and timing, enabling precise adjustments for different fabric types and paper combinations.

items.title: Conveyor Belt Fabric Pickup System
items.desc: Integrated conveyor belt automatically collects transferred fabric after the drum, simplifying post-transfer handling, reducing operator workload, and maintaining production flow without manual collection.

items.title: Pre-Cut Piece Table
items.desc: Dedicated flat table with alignment guides allows operators to accurately position and feed pre-cut garment pieces into the drum for consistent, registered transfer on cut components.

items.title: Adjustable Speed and Pressure Control
items.desc: Variable speed and pressure settings allow operators to fine-tune transfer parameters for different fabric weights, polyester compositions, and design coverage levels across all production runs.

items.title: Built-In Cooling Timer
items.desc: Integrated automatic cooldown timer manages safe drum temperature reduction after production stops, protecting machine components and ensuring operator safety at the end of every shift.

idealFor.description: Perfectly suited for a wide range of sublimation finishing applications, delivering consistent transfer quality, vibrant colour, and production efficiency across polyester fabrics.

fabrics.title: Sublimation Transfer Finishing for SubPro and Alpha Series Users
fabrics.desc: The natural downstream partner for any SubPro or Alpha series sublimation printer, completing the transfer workflow from printed paper to finished fabric at matched industrial output speeds.

fabrics.title: High-Volume Polyester Fashion Fabric Finishing
fabrics.desc: Roll-to-roll transfer at up to 600 m/hr suits manufacturers producing large volumes of polyester sarees, dress materials, and fashion fabrics who need calender capacity to match sublimation printer output.

fabrics.title: Sportswear and Activewear Piece Transfer
fabrics.desc: Pre-cut piece table and adjustable pressure settings make the Pengda well suited to garment manufacturers transferring sublimation designs onto individual cut polyester components before assembly.

fabrics.title: Home Textile and Soft Furnishing Production
fabrics.desc: High-speed roll-to-roll transfer on polyester curtains, cushion cover fabric, upholstery, and decorative furnishing textiles for manufacturers integrating calender finishing into their production line.

fabrics.title: Job Work Calender Services
fabrics.desc: Manufacturers offering calender finishing as a service to sublimation printers and garment producers who outsource transfer fusing to dedicated calender operations.

fabrics.title: Integrated Production Lines
fabrics.desc: Roll-to-roll and piece transfer modes in one machine make the Pengda the most versatile calender option for integrated facilities printing, transferring, and finishing polyester textiles under one roof.

productionCapacity.description: Choose the ideal transfer mode and speed to optimize finishing output and transfer quality.

globalComponents.description: Built using premium international components that deliver superior accuracy, durability, and consistent transfer efficiency.

smallCards.title: Touch Panel Control Interface
smallCards.desc: Intuitive operator interface for real-time control of speed, temperature, and timing parameters across all transfer modes

smallCards.title: Conveyor Belt Fabric Pickup Unit

smallCards.title: Pre-Cut Piece Transfer Table
smallCards.desc: Dedicated alignment and feed table for consistent, registered transfer on pre-cut garment panels and fabric pieces

smallCards.title: Adjustable Pressure and Speed Control System

smallCards.title: Built-In Cooling Timer System
smallCards.desc: Automated cooldown management for safe drum temperature reduction after production and at shift end

smallCards.title: Winder Unit

smallCards.title: Control Systems — Omron (Japan)
